prusalink.title: PrusaSlicer 2 Connector
prusalink.intro: PrusaSlicer 2.4 and later sends a print to this printer as it sends one to a printer with PrusaLink.
prusalink.created: Copy the API key now. It works for every printer you may operate, so you can paste the same key for each of them. This server keeps only its hash and does not show it again. It is listed under Settings, API credentials, where you can revoke it.
prusalink.plainHttp: This address is plain HTTP, so the key crosses your network unencrypted. Where the server has an HTTPS address, paste that one into PrusaSlicer instead.
prusalink.steps.title: In PrusaSlicer
prusalink.steps.add: Next to the printer profile, click Add physical printer.
prusalink.steps.host: Set Host type to PrusaLink and paste the address into Hostname, IP or URL.
prusalink.steps.key: Set Authorization type to API key and paste the API key.
prusalink.steps.test: Click Test. Upload and Print then sends the file to this printer, and Upload keeps it on this server.
